authority: OE51 yes to low for pure jojoba plus request to reuse natural-base documentation; OE14 approximate estimates. No sensory or intake validation.

basis_reference.reuse: Exact identity/aliases and material observations only. Weight entries remain unchanged; no weight-to-build-up mapping.

matching: Case-insensitive exact canonical or already-reviewed alias after whitespace normalization; no substring, derivative or plant-part collapse.
application_rule: Use the prior for a complete single-ingredient whole-oil declaration. For blends, annotate the constituent clue and assess the complete retained architecture; it cannot decide the finished blend. Source-specific contrary evidence or a decisive grade ambiguity requires fresh review/unknown.

entries.identity_limits: Do not match Jojoba Esters, Hydrolyzed Jojoba Esters, Hydrogenated Jojoba Oil, Isopropyl Jojobate or PEG derivatives.

build_up_prior.reason: OE51 accepted practical whole-jojoba prior. Existing exact-material documentation identifies a fluid liquid wax; at comparable small retained applications this supports a weak-coating hypothesis. This is an explicitly approved rough material inference, not a deduction from light weight or measured repeated washout.

evidence.observation: Existing reference records liquid-wax/fluidity context; reused only as bounded material-inference support.

counter_signal: Fluidity does not establish low deposited mass, easy shampoo removal or repeated accumulation.
Whole jojoba leaves a retained lipid coating; dose, grade, temperature and reapplication affect actual residue.
unresolved: No controlled comparative repeat-application/shampoo hair-residue measurement establishes this class.

coverage.meaning: This companion adds one assessed build-up prior; it does not claim all 68 base-oil build-up tendencies are complete.
